changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE agent_action DROP CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_kind, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_kind CHECK (kind IN ('EMAIL','FILE_ISSUE','DELIVER_FEEDBACK','EDIT_FEEDBACK', 'RETRACT_FEEDBACK','SLACK_POST','PUBLISH_REPORT','CLEANUP_ISSUE','TRANSFER_ISSUE')), DROP CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_workspace, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_workspace CHECK (workspace_id IS NOT NULL OR kind IN ('EMAIL','FILE_ISSUE','PUBLISH_REPORT','CLEANUP_ISSUE','TRANSFER_ISSUE'));
